facts.statement: The genus Rhomaleodus was first described by Andreev and Cuny in 2012.
Fossils of Rhomaleodus date to the Middle Triassic period.
This extinct genus is known from the Anisian stage of the Middle Triassic in Bulgaria.
facts.quote: known from the Middle Triassic (Anisian stage) of Bulgaria

facts.statement: Plamen S. Andreev and Gilles Cuny named the genus Rhomaleodus in 2012.
facts.quote: It was first named by Plamen S. Andreev and Gilles Cuny in 2012

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Rhomaleodus budurovi.
facts.quote: the type species is Rhomaleodus budurovi

facts.statement: While originally placed in Selachii incertae sedis, later studies suggested Rhomaleodus belongs within the Synechodontiformes.
facts.quote: While originally identified as a member of Selachii incertae sedis', later studies suggested a placement within the Synechodontiformes

facts.statement: The parent group of Rhomaleodus is Neoselachii.
Rhomaleodus is classified in the class Chondrichthyes.
There are two recorded fossil occurrences of Rhomaleodus in the Paleobiology Database.

rejected.statement: Rhomaleodus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish.
rejected.quote: Rhomaleodus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish
